items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: They gave more credit to fellas like Thomas Jefferson, than they gave to Rene.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was, you know what I mean, he don't get the credit that he really deserved. They gave more credit to fellas like Thomas Jefferson, than they gave to Rene. But you see, them old fellas and band leaders, they used to pull some deals off. I played with T-Boy Remy. And he took me on a job up to Raceland. I didn't know it was going to be a taxi dance. Yeah. I'm looking for a player that we have intermission. He said, what you want to stop for? I said, man, at least I got to go in the trailer, get a drink. Go…
